title: Podcast monetization beyond the midroll: multiplatform campaigns, brand guests and reporting
summary: Casey Adams moderates a Podcast Movement panel with brand buyers from Timeline and Caraway on moving past midroll ads into multiplatform partnerships. His own contributions are framing points: brand experts as guests, using missed-impression reporting to upsell multiplatform, and reporting that earns renewals. Most of the substantive insight comes from the panelists, not Casey.

principles.text: Brands putting their own experts (CEO, head scientist) on a show is an under-discussed monetization format beyond the ad read.
principles.quote: I love when I've worked with brands in the past for my show and they say, "Hey, you should have our CEO on the show or a head scientist."

principles.text: Show brands the impressions they missed on other formats to move audio-only deals into multiplatform campaigns.
principles.quote: They might just be doing audio, but then they'll show them, hey, you missed out on 20 million impressions of the short form that for the next one, let's do that instead.

principles.text: For complex products, team experts as guests deliver customer education a short ad read cannot.
principles.quote: there's like multiple people on the team that will bring that customer education, which is so vital on the shows themselves as guests.

principles.text: Publishers should understand what brands care about and report campaigns accordingly, with renewals as the goal.
principles.quote: they are hearing things from the brands understanding what they care about understanding the things that you've the dos and the don'ts and then kind of their best representing the campaign to them for the goal of getting renewals
